subject: Junior Design Engineer application, Marc Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Junior Design Engineer
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Junior Design Engineer position supporting the Capital Works Program. Concept and detailed design for roads, drainage, cycling infrastructure, car parks and traffic calming is the work my diploma was built around, and I want to do it under a Senior Design Engineer in a council team.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. The coursework had me design and document road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepare and review construction drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D applying Australian Standards and Austroads guides. I compared design options and wrote up the choice, prepared cost estimates, kept risk registers, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries to design around existing services. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

My site experience is from the Philippines in 2019 and 2020: site inspections, quality checks, drawing reviews, progress records and coordination with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers on two small projects. It gave me a practical feel for what a drawing has to show for the crew to build it.

I have not worked to Main Roads WA standards yet and would learn them with the team. I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint daily. I hold an Australian driver's licence, which I would transfer to WA on relocating from Melton, Victoria, a current White Card, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, which covers the fixed term to June 2027.
My CV is attached and my drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering my application.

screening_answers.question: Completed or currently undertaking a tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering or related
screening_answers.answer: Completed: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) and Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Australia, February 2026).

screening_answers.question: Qualification or formal training in AutoCAD and/or Civil 3D
screening_answers.answer: Yes, both, through the Advanced Diploma (2024 to 2026).

screening_answers.question: Knowledge of Australian Standards, Austroads Guides and Main Roads WA standards
screening_answers.answer: Australian Standards and Austroads guides: applied in coursework. Main Roads WA standards: not yet used; willing to learn.

screening_answers.question: Current WA Driver’s Licence and White Card
screening_answers.answer: Australian (Victorian) licence, to be transferred to WA on relocation; current White Card.

checklist: Open the City of Vincent jobs board from the SEEK Apply button and find Junior Design Engineer.
Attach the two PDFs from this record (CV and cover letter).
Answer any questions using the suggested answers above.
Submit before 5:00pm Wednesday 30 September 2026 (Perth time). This one is urgent.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Closes 30 September 2026 5pm AWST. Perth relocation. Contact Jacob Beets by phone only; no email published.
